t: What he made inviolable in the farewell sermon
a: فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا
p: Fa-inna dimāʾakum wa amwālakum wa aʿrāḍakum baynakum ḥarāmun ka-ḥurmati yawmikum hādhā, fī shahrikum hādhā, fī baladikum hādhā
m: Your blood, your property and your honour are sacred among you, like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours.
